title: ‘Spider-Man: Brand New Day’ scores second-largest global opening ever
facts: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' generated an estimated $355 million across North American theaters during its opening weekend.
'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' grossed $572 million internationally for an opening global total of $927 million.
The global box office opening of 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' ranks second all-time behind 'Avengers: Endgame'.
'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' stars Tom Holland and Zendaya.
'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' was produced by Columbia Pictures, Marvel Studios, and Pascal Pictures.
The production budget for 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' was approximately $225 million.
Kevin Feige serves as President of Marvel Studios and producer of 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day'.
The 2021 film 'Spider-Man: No Way Home' achieved an opening domestic weekend gross of $260 million.
Amy Pascal served as a producer on the Spider-Man film franchise.
Christopher Nolan's feature film 'The Odyssey' grossed $51 million domestically in its holdover weekend.
'The Odyssey' reached a cumulative global box office gross of $911.4 million.
Universal Pictures became the first film studio in 2026 to exceed $4 billion in annual global box office revenue.
Pixar's 'Toy Story 5' grossed $6.3 million domestically, reaching a worldwide total exceeding $1.06 billion.
Universal and Illumination's 'Minions & Monsters' earned $5.8 million at the weekend box office.
Tom Rothman serves as Chairman of Sony Pictures Motion Picture Group.
